_comment: Merge this into your project's .claude/settings.json -- `search-audit-cli.js install-guard --project <dir>` does it for you and rewrites ARIS_DIST to this checkout's dist directory. Refuses network calls that name what the tester built its held-out cases on, and appends every network call to .aris/search-audit.jsonl. This is keyword and domain matching, NOT a sandbox: a paraphrase, a synonym or a typo goes through, and the benchmark is probably in the model's weights already. It stops the cheap contamination path (typing the benchmark's name into a search box) and nothing more. With no .aris/search-policy.json present it refuses every network call rather than allowing them.
